cards.name: Ithacan Sailor
cards.text: Ruse: Gain +1/+1.
cards.flavor: He would follow his captain past the edge of the map.
cards.art: A weathered young sailor in a short tunic hauls on a rope at the side of a small Greek ship.

cards.name: Puccio Sciancato
cards.text: On Play: Copy a random card from the enemy's hand into yours.
cards.flavor: Of the five thieves, he alone kept his own shape.
cards.art: A limping thief in a ragged cloak glances back over his shoulder as serpents coil on the rocks around him.

cards.name: Tongue of Flame
cards.text: Deal 1 damage. Ruse: Deal 2 more.
cards.flavor: The tip of the flame shook, like a tongue trying to speak.
cards.art: A single tall flame shaped like a tongue flickers above a dark rocky ditch, sparks flying from its tip.

cards.name: Counterfeit Florins
cards.text: Draw a card. Ruse: Gain 1 Mana this turn only.
cards.flavor: Three carats of dross in every coin, and Florence never noticed.
cards.art: A pile of gold coins spills from a crucible on a forge, a hammer and a coin die beside them.

cards.name: Forged Will
cards.text: Copy a minion into your hand.
cards.flavor: Schicchi lay in a dead man's bed and dictated a will in his voice.
cards.art: A hand holding a quill signs a long parchment by candlelight while a dead man lies in the bed behind.

cards.name: Turn the Prow
cards.text: Return a friendly minion to your hand.
cards.flavor: We turned our stern to the morning and made wings of our oars.
cards.art: A small Greek ship swings its curved prow around on a dark sea, its sail filling with wind.

cards.name: Old Companions
cards.text: Ruse: Draw a card.
cards.flavor: We were old and slow by the time we reached the narrow strait.
cards.art: Three grey-bearded sailors sit together at the oars of a ship, tired but still pulling.

cards.name: Wandering Flames
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions. Ruse: Deal 1 more.
cards.flavor: Each flame steals a sinner away, and no one sees him inside.
cards.art: Dozens of small flames drift like fireflies along the bottom of a deep stone valley at night.

cards.name: Griffolino of Arezzo
cards.text: Ruse: Gain Swift.
cards.flavor: He joked that he could fly. The fool who believed him had him burned.
cards.art: A scrawny alchemist in a stained robe stands on a rooftop with his arms spread as if to fly.

cards.name: Beacon Keeper
cards.text: On Play: Deal 1 damage. Ruse: Deal 1 more.
cards.flavor: A fire on the shore can guide a ship home, or onto the rocks.
cards.art: A hooded man raises a burning torch beside a tall signal fire on a cliff above the sea.

cards.name: Achaean in Hiding
cards.text: Last Breath: Summon a 2/2 Achaean Raider.
cards.flavor: Inside the horse, no one dared to breathe.
cards.art: A Greek soldier crouches in the dark belly of a wooden structure, gripping his sword and holding his breath.

cards.name: Barbed Counsel
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. Ruse: Draw a card.
cards.flavor: Good advice, given for a bad end.
cards.art: A cloaked adviser whispers into the ear of a crowned king, a thin dagger hidden behind his back.

cards.name: Spoils of Troy
cards.text: Copy 2 random cards from the enemy's deck into your hand.
cards.flavor: Troy burned, and the Greeks sailed home heavy with its treasure.
cards.art: Greek soldiers carry chests, golden cups and bronze shields out of a burning city gate.

cards.name: Buoso Donati
cards.text: Last Breath: Summon a 2/2 Serpent with Venom.
cards.flavor: The man became a serpent, and the serpent became a man.
cards.art: A man's body twists as his legs turn into the tail of a great serpent, smoke rising around him.

cards.name: Oarsmen of Ithaca
cards.text: Ruse: Gain +1/+1.
cards.flavor: Our oars became wings for that mad flight.
cards.art: A row of muscular oarsmen bend to their long oars in the hull of a galley on rough water.

cards.name: Gilded Hypocrite
cards.text: Guard.
cards.flavor: His cloak shines like gold outside. It is lead all the way through.
cards.art: A hooded monk trudges forward under a heavy cloak that shines like gold but drags like lead.

cards.name: Burning Counsellor
cards.text: Last Breath: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
cards.flavor: Every one of these flames wraps a sinner who gave false counsel.
cards.art: An old adviser in a long robe stands wrapped in a column of fire, one hand raised as he speaks.

cards.name: Speech of Fire
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Ruse: Deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
cards.flavor: The flame spoke, and its words came out as fire.
cards.art: A flame bends and shapes itself into a speaking mouth, words of sparks pouring out over a ravine.

cards.name: Eurypylus, the Augur
cards.text: On Play: Copy a random card from the enemy's deck into your hand.
cards.flavor: He and Calchas chose the hour when the fleet would sail.
cards.art: A Greek augur in a white robe reads the flight of birds above a beach full of ships.

cards.name: Night Raid
cards.text: Summon two 2/2 Achaean Raiders.
cards.flavor: Two men went into the Trojan camp by night, and came back with its horses.
cards.art: Two Greek warriors creep through an enemy camp at night, spears low, past sleeping guards.

cards.name: The Little Ship
cards.text: Last Breath: Summon two 2/1 Ithacan Sailors.
cards.flavor: One ship, and the few companions who never left me.
cards.art: A small single-masted Greek ship sails alone across a vast open sea under a low sky.

cards.name: Past the Pillars
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Ruse: Draw 1 more.
cards.flavor: Hercules set his markers so no one would sail further. We sailed further.
cards.art: A small ship sails between two enormous stone pillars rising from the sea at the edge of the world.

cards.name: Achaean Captain
cards.text: Ruse: Summon two 2/2 Achaean Raiders.
cards.flavor: Ten years at the walls, and still he leads the charge.
cards.art: A Greek captain in a crested bronze helmet raises his sword and shouts orders to his men.

cards.name: Epeius, Horse-Builder
cards.text: On Play: Summon a 2/2 Achaean Raider.
cards.flavor: He built a gift so fine that Troy broke its own wall to let it in.
cards.art: A bearded carpenter with an adze works on the huge wooden leg of an unfinished horse.

cards.name: The Sweet Siren
cards.text: Ruse: Freeze a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: "I am the sweet siren who turned Ulysses from his course."
cards.art: A pale siren sits on a rock above the waves and sings, her long hair blowing toward a passing ship.

cards.name: Fra Gomita
cards.text: On Play: Gain 1 Mana this turn only.
cards.flavor: He sold every office in Gallura, and never tired of talking about it.
cards.art: A friar with a sly smile weighs a fat purse of coins in his hand behind a judge's bench.

cards.name: Absolved in Advance
cards.text: Give a friendly minion Rebirth. Draw a card.
cards.flavor: "I absolve you now," said the Pope, "for the sin you are about to commit."
cards.art: A pope in a tall tiara raises two fingers in blessing over a kneeling knight in armour.

cards.name: Curio, the Tongueless
cards.text: Ruse: Silence a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He told Caesar to cross the river. Now he has no tongue to speak with.
cards.art: A Roman tribune in a torn toga stands mute in a dark ravine, one hand pressed over his mouth.

cards.name: Potiphar's Wife
cards.text: On Play: Freeze an enemy minion. Ruse: Silence it.
cards.flavor: She lied about Joseph, and now she burns with fever.
cards.art: A richly dressed Egyptian noblewoman holds up a torn cloak and points accusingly into the shadows.

cards.name: Circe's Draught
cards.text: Transform a minion into a 1/1 Swine.
cards.flavor: One sip, and proud men were rooting in the dirt.
cards.art: A golden cup of glowing potion is held out by a woman's hand, a pig sniffing at the floor below.

cards.name: Calchas, the Augur
cards.text: Start of Turn: Copy a random card from the enemy's deck into your hand.
cards.flavor: The augur read the birds and sent the Greeks to sea.
cards.art: An old seer with a staff stands on a shore at dawn, pointing at the sky above a fleet of ships.

cards.name: Sinon, the False Greek
cards.text: Ruse: Return a random enemy minion to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor: His lie did what ten years of war could not.
cards.art: A Greek prisoner in chains pleads before Trojan soldiers, a giant wooden horse looming behind him.

cards.name: False Beacon
cards.text: Freeze an enemy minion. Ruse: Freeze all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: Wreckers light their fires where the reefs are sharpest.
cards.art: A bonfire burns on a rocky headland at night, luring a ship toward jagged reefs.

cards.name: Envoy to Troy
cards.text: On Play: Copy 2 random cards from the enemy's hand into yours.
cards.flavor: He came to talk of peace, and counted every spear on the walls.
cards.art: A Greek envoy in a travelling cloak bows before the high walls and gate of Troy.

cards.name: The Greek Ambush
cards.text: Summon a 2/2 Achaean Raider. Ruse: Summon another.
cards.flavor: They waited in the reeds until the patrol passed.
cards.art: Greek soldiers leap from tall reeds by a riverbank, spears raised, onto a startled patrol.

cards.name: Arms of Achilles
cards.text: Give a friendly minion +2/+2. Ruse: Give it Ward.
cards.flavor: Ajax wanted the armour. Ulysses spoke better, and Ajax went mad.
cards.art: A magnificent bronze shield, helmet and spear lie on a cloth before a crowd of Greek chiefs.

cards.name: Theft of the Palladium
cards.text: Steal the top 2 cards of the enemy's deck.
cards.flavor: While Troy kept its statue, Troy could not fall. So we stole it.
cards.art: Two Greek warriors carry a small wooden statue of a goddess out of a dark temple at night.

cards.name: The Two-Horned Flame
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to an enemy. Ruse: Deal 3 damage to the enemy hero.
cards.flavor: Two sinners in one fire, because they ran to ruin together.
cards.art: One great flame split at the top into two horns burns in a deep ravine, two faces dimly inside it.

cards.name: Simon Magus
cards.text: On Play: Copy 2 random cards from the enemy's deck into your hand.
cards.flavor: He offered silver for a gift that cannot be bought.
cards.art: A sorcerer in a dark robe holds out a bag of silver toward two robed apostles who turn away.

cards.name: Capocchio, the Ape
cards.text: On Play: Summon a copy of an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: "Remember what a good ape of nature I was."
cards.art: A scabby alchemist crouches over a bench of flasks and mimics the pose of a man before him like an ape.

cards.name: Valley of Flames
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to all enemy minions. Ruse: Deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
cards.flavor: As many flames as the fireflies a farmer sees on a summer evening.
cards.art: A deep stone valley seen from a bridge above, filled from end to end with countless moving flames.

cards.name: The Little Speech
cards.text: Give your minions +1/+1. Ruse: Give them +1 Attack.
cards.flavor: "You were not made to live like brutes, but to follow virtue and knowledge."
cards.art: An old captain stands at the mast and speaks to his gathered crew, all of them turned toward the sunset.

cards.name: Deidamia, the Deceived
cards.text: Last Breath: Add Achilles, Swift-Footed to your hand.
cards.flavor: Even dead, she grieves for Achilles, whom Ulysses lured away to war.
cards.art: A young princess weeps alone in a palace room, holding a dress left behind on an empty chair.

cards.name: Diomedes, the Twin Flame
cards.text: Ruse: Summon a copy of this minion.
cards.flavor: They went to their ruin together, and together they burn.
cards.art: A Greek warrior in a plumed helmet stands inside a tall flame, a second figure sharing the fire beside him.

cards.name: The Trojan Horse
cards.text: Guard. Last Breath: Summon three 2/2 Achaean Raiders.
cards.flavor: It looked like an offering. It was a door.
cards.art: A gigantic wooden horse on wheels stands before the walls of Troy, a hatch half open in its belly.

cards.name: The Black Cherub
cards.text: On Play: Steal a random card from the enemy's hand.
cards.flavor: "Perhaps you did not think that I was a logician!"
cards.art: A black-winged demon swoops down and seizes a dying friar's soul from the hands of a saint.

cards.name: Circe, the Enchantress
cards.text: On Play: Transform all enemy minions into 1/1 Swine.
cards.flavor: She kept me more than a year near Gaeta.
cards.art: A sorceress on a stone throne raises a wand over men who are turning into pigs at her feet.

cards.name: The Distant Mountain
cards.text: On Play: Return all other minions to their owners' hands.
cards.flavor: A mountain, dark with distance, higher than any I had seen. Then the whirlwind came.
cards.art: A dark mountain rises from the open sea while a whirlwind spins a small ship toward the waves.

cards.name: Ulysses, the Schemer
cards.text: On Play: Return an enemy minion to its owner's hand. Ruse: Keep a copy.
cards.flavor: He talked his crew past the edge of the world, and none of them came home.
cards.art: A helmeted man at a ship's prow beside a lit beacon fire on dark water.

cards.flavor: Out of the belly of the horse, into the sleeping city.
cards.name: Achaean Raider
cards.art: A Greek soldier in a bronze helmet charges forward with a short sword and a round shield.

cards.flavor: Circe's guests always stay for good.
cards.name: Swine of Circe
cards.art: A bewildered pig with strangely human eyes stands in the straw of a sty.
